title: Ways to Make a Fair Array
description: Find the number of indices such that if removed, the sum of even-indexed elements equals the sum of odd-indexed elements.
pseudocode:
1. totalEven = sum of all even indices, totalOdd = sum of all odd indices
2. for i in 0 to n-1:
3.   if i % 2 == 0: currentEven = totalEven - nums[i]
4.   else: currentOdd = totalOdd - nums[i]
5.   if (currentEven + prevOdd) == (currentOdd + prevEven): count++
6.   if i % 2 == 0: prevEven += nums[i]
7.   else: prevOdd += nums[i]

steps.note: Calculate initial prefix sums: totalEven=2, totalOdd=1
i=0: Remove nums[0]. Even sum becomes 0, Odd sum stays 1. 0 != 1.
i=1: Remove nums[1]. Odd sum becomes 0, Even sum remains 1. 1 == 0? No.
i=2: Remove nums[2]. Even sum becomes 1, Odd sum is 1. 1 == 1! count++.
